paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the training loss of a reward model across successive training steps. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step" and operates on a linear scale with a visible range from 0 to 1400, featuring numeric tick labels spaced at regular intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Training Loss" and also utilizes a linear scale, displaying numeric tick labels from 0.3 to 0.7 at intervals of 0.1. The data is represented by a single solid blue line without markers, identified in the legend as "Training Loss of Reward Model." The line begins at its maximum recorded value of approximately 0.76 at training step 0 and experiences a steep, rapid decline, dropping to roughly 0.4 by training step 100. Following this initial sharp decrease, the line continues to decline at a slower rate while exhibiting frequent, jagged fluctuations. It reaches a value of approximately 0.35 by step 400, after which the downward slope becomes very slight, maintaining a relatively steady, fluctuating trend until it ends at a final value near 0.3 at approximately training step 1370.
